findings.claim: The plan omits the required reflection finish condition and explicitly stops before performing it, so executing all thirteen tasks cannot complete the supplied phase goal.
findings.evidence: Goals line 6 requires the change to "finish with one completed-boundary operation and reflection," while plan line 95 says "After Execute, stop for feedback; Reflect/archive and parent restoration follow their own lifecycle," and task 13 at line 54 only records a learning/handoff and says to stop before reflect.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an ordered post-feedback reflection step with an explicit dependency on task 13 and define its completion artifact, while keeping archive and parent restoration separately gated if required.
